_comment: Copy to site/business.json (git-ignored) and fill every field. Empty fields show on the site as a red 'to fill' mark, except seller_legal, seller_address and registration: the seller line skips them and an empty registration shows a 'not registered yet' note. A key ending in _uk overrides that key on the Ukrainian pages. checkout_fields: 'yes' when the payment page itself asks for the company website (Stripe custom fields), 'no' when buyers send it by email. mor_note: one sentence when a merchant of record sells on your behalf (Paddle, Lemon Squeezy), else empty. self_host_fonts: 'yes' serves design/fonts at /fonts/ (no Google request). order_mode: 'email' = the order form opens the buyer's email app with the request to order_email; you reply with a payment link. 'form' = the site's order form posts to the Cloudflare function that creates a Plata by mono invoice (set MONO_TOKEN and PRICE_KOP in Cloudflare); 'link' = a plain payment link (payment_link_en/_uk).
ai_models: OpenAI (answers for the AI-visibility check) and Anthropic (Claude, the agents that read sources and write the report)
seo_note: SEO data from paid tools (Ahrefs) is not included in paid reports for now.
seo_note_uk: SEO-дані з платних інструментів (Ahrefs) поки не входять у платні звіти.
